intro.title: ABOUT
intro.paragraph: Kraqen Innovations translates brand moments into visceral perspectives, flexing between the quietude of the ethereal and the grit of the expressive. We are a close-knit production team drawn to ideas with texture, movement and feeling, shaping each frame with cinematic intent from first conversation through final delivery.

members.name: VICTOR YUEN
members.bio: Victor has worked in the creative industry for more than a decade, collaborating with clients at every scale. With a background in design, he puts storytelling and strong visual direction at the forefront of every project. From large in-house creative teams to small businesses, he finds the most compelling way through each production.
members.alt: Victor Yuen, Founder and Creative Director at Kraqen Innovations

members.name: MAX TAGESEN
members.bio: Max is a multidisciplinary creator with an undying passion for sport. He tells real, meaningful stories through photography and video, looking for the emotion and movement that make each frame unique. No project is too small or too large. If there is a story worth telling, he is all in.
members.alt: Max Tagesen, Editor and Camera Operator at Kraqen Innovations
